name: Fx-Work
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA plus gated linear attention: 30 of 40 layers are linear_attention and 10 are full_attention, one every fourth layer
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 35.952 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-29. Caveats: the card prints an AVG column that includes GDPval Elo normalized, APEX and JobBench Main; GDPval Elo is not a percentage (1352 vs 1053) and is stored with scale 100 as a placeholder like other Elo rows in the catalog. Vision encoder inherited from base; single-run vendor evaluation.
